comment: APP-AUTHORED chapel administration state (staff Schedule → Chapels / Availability).
SHAPE: `chapels` maps a scheduling resource (scheduling-resources GET /resources, ids match
scheduling/resources.json) to the park's OWN facts about that chapel — its sheet class
(common|private), capacity, active flag and staff notes. `blocks` are operator-entered
closed date ranges (maintenance/private use), `booking_states` the app-authored
confirmation/cancellation records for a scheduling booking (reason, linked order, actor).
NO frozen contract names any of this: booking-events-v1 (KEB-D3-03) defers resource
maintenance windows and exposes no resource write endpoint, so live mode answers 503 for
these writes instead of inventing one (lib/api-client/chapel-admin.ts).
PLACEHOLDER — the client has NOT confirmed how many chapels the park has, their names or
which class each sells as. The two seeded rows are the frozen schedule fixture's Chapel A /
Chapel B (the same mapping lib/chapel-booking.ts's CHAPEL_CLASS_RULES carries as the
fallback). Staff edit this list on /staff/schedule; the customer booking dialog reads it
immediately (same store), and tests/fixture-contract/chapel-admin.test.ts pins the seed to
the scheduling resources fixture so the two cannot drift.
DEMO DATA ONLY: fixture-mode only, persisted through lib/api-client/chapel-store.ts
(.data/scheduling-chapel-admin.json, gitignored) with this file as the read-only seed.
